items.name: cta-001
items.title: Призыв с горизонтом
items.description: Финальная секция призыва: тёмное пятно в конце светлой страницы, одно главное действие и снимающая возражение строка под ним.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-cta-001-*. Кегль заголовка считается в cqi от собственной ширины блока, поэтому секция одинаково верна в миниатюре каталога и на живой странице. Свечение — один радиальный градиент в отдельном слое с pointer-events:none, а не заливка фона. Второе действие намеренно сделано ссылкой, а не второй кнопкой.

ai.summary: Финальная секция призыва: тёмный фон, свет из-за горизонта, надзаголовок-плашка, крупный заголовок, объяснение, одна кнопка и текстовая ссылка рядом. Под кнопками — мелкая строка, снимающая возражение перед кликом. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, своя палитра, клиентского JS нет.

ограничение ширины заголовка и описания в ch — строка длиннее не читается
блок <style> внутри компонента — в нём вся палитра, свечение и раскладка
light-dark() в палитре: компонент обязан следовать color-scheme окружения, а не носить собственную тёмную тему

Секция ставится в конце страницы. Две таких на одной странице обесценивают друг друга.
Не превращайте note в мелкий шрифт с условиями: это одна короткая фраза, а не сноска.
Не убирайте описание совсем — заголовок без объяснения работает только там, где продукт уже понятен.
Не выносите CSS-переменные в globals.css: блок обязан оставаться одним файлом.

en.description: A closing call to action: a dark block at the end of a light page, one primary action and a line beneath it that answers the last objection.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-001-* variables. The heading size is computed in cqi against the block's own width, so the section is equally correct in a catalogue thumbnail and on a live page. The glow is a single radial gradient in a separate layer with pointer-events:none, not a background fill. The second action is deliberately made a link rather than a second button.

ai.summary: A closing call-to-action section: a dark ground, light rising from behind the horizon, an eyebrow pill, a large heading, an explanation, one button and a text link beside it. A small line under the buttons removes the last objection before the click. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-cta-001-* palette — the section stays dark in both light-dark() branches: the contrast with the rest of the page is the design of this block, so the background is not made transparent here
the single primary button: the second action stays a link, otherwise the choice splits exactly where it must not
the note line under the buttons: it answers the objection at the moment of decision rather than in a terms page
the glow as its own layer with pointer-events:none — a background fill would eat the text contrast
the heading size in cqi against the block's own width: media queries give a mobile size inside a narrow column
the ch-based width limits on heading and description — a longer line stops being read
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the glow and the layout
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: the eyebrow, title, description and note copy
primaryAction and secondaryAction — labels and destinations
the accent through the accent prop — it colours the glow, the pill and the button
outer spacing through className: the section spans its parent's width
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
This belongs at the end of a page. Two of them on one page devalue each other.
Do not turn the note into fine print: it is one short phrase, not a footnote.
Do not drop the description entirely — a heading alone works only where the product is already understood.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

items.name: cta-003
items.title: Призыв подписаться
items.description: Призыв с формой почты: настоящая форма с видимой подписью поля, честным согласием и строкой про частоту писем — вместо голого поля с кнопкой.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-cta-003-*. Серверный компонент: поле неуправляемое, форма отправляется обычным POST и работает до гидратации. Подпись поля видимая и связана через htmlFor, а не спрятана в placeholder: подпись внутри поля исчезает при заполнении, ровно когда нужнее. От 38rem поле и кнопка встают в один ряд через grid-template-columns:1fr auto, до этого идут колонкой. Заголовок набран засечной гарнитурой — рассылка про интерфейсы обязана выглядеть как текст, а не как форма.

  submitLabel="Подписаться"
  frequency="Два письма в месяц"
  subscribers="6 400 читателей"
/>
ai.summary: Секция подписки на рассылку: засечный заголовок, объяснение содержания писем, форма с видимой подписью поля, согласие мелким шрифтом и строка про частоту и число читателей. Форма настоящая и работает без клиентского кода. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, своя палитра.

en.description: An email capture CTA: a real form with a visible field label, honest consent text and a line about how often letters arrive — instead of a bare input with a button.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-003-* variables. A server component: the field is uncontrolled, the form is submitted by a plain POST and works before hydration. The field label is visible and tied through htmlFor rather than hidden in the placeholder: a label inside the field disappears once the field is filled in, exactly when it is needed most. From 38rem the field and the button stand in one row through grid-template-columns:1fr auto; below that they run as a column. The heading is set in a serif face — a newsletter about interfaces has to look like text, not like a form.

items.name: cta-004
items.title: Призыв на цветной плашке
items.description: Призыв к действию на сплошной цветной плите: крупная цифра-доказательство и одна светлая кнопка. Меняются цвет плиты, цифра, текст и адрес кнопки.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-cta-004-*. Серверный компонент. Узор — два repeating-linear-gradient в отдельном слое с pointer-events:none, погашенный mask-image к левому нижнему углу, поэтому текст всегда лежит на спокойном месте. Плита градиентная, а не одноцветная: сплошная заливка на всю ширину выглядит как ошибка стиля. Раскладка от собственной ширины: до 46rem одна колонка, дальше текст и блок с цифрой встают рядом, причём правая колонка выравнивается по правому краю.

items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-cta-011-*. Серверный компонент. Код-плашка тёмная в обеих темах: терминал не бывает светло-серым, и команда должна читаться как команда. Панель для команд подкрашена тёплым тинтом через color-mix — веса панелей различаются, но обе остаются настоящими входами. Длинная команда прокручивается по горизонтали, а не ломает раскладку. От 44rem панели встают рядом равными долями.

en.title: Two Paths CTA
en.description: Two panels for two audiences: a developer gets an npx command in a code plate, a team gets a demo button. The entries differ because decisions are made differently.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-011-* variables. A server component. The code plate is dark in both themes: a terminal is never light grey, and a command has to read as a command. The teams panel is tinted warm through color-mix — the panels differ in weight, yet both remain real entry points. A long command scrolls horizontally instead of breaking the layout. From 44rem the panels stand side by side in equal shares.

ai.summary: A section with two paths to the product: a developers panel with an npx command in a dark code plate and a documentation link, and a teams panel with a demo button. No client JS. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.

items.title: Призыв с доверием
items.description: Призыв с социальным доказательством: под кнопкой стопка аватаров-инициалов и строка «5 000+ команд уже строят». Аватары рисуются из имён, без картинок.

Аватары — круги с инициалами, вычисленными из имён: без внешних файлов и без стоковых лиц. en.title: Social Proof CTA
en.description: A CTA with social proof: under the button a stack of initial avatars and a line saying "5,000+ teams already build". The avatars are drawn from names, no images.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-012-* variables. A server component. The avatars are circles with initials computed from names: no external files and no stock faces. The stack overlaps through a negative margin, and the ring around each circle is drawn with box-shadow to imitate the page colour. The whole stack is aria-hidden: what matters to a screen reader is the proof line, not the decoration.

ai.summary: A centred CTA: an eyebrow, a heading, an explanation, one button, and beneath it a stack of initial avatars with a social proof line. No client JS. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.

aria-hidden on the avatar stack — a screen reader needs the proof line, not the decorative circles
the circle overlap ringed through box-shadow: a semi-transparent border would show the neighbouring avatar through itself
the proof line next to the stack — a number without faces reads as statistics, faces without a number as decoration; they work together
the single button: social proof props up one action, not a menu
the heading size in cqi from the block's own width
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the avatars and the layout
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

Four to six names are enough: a longer stack turns into a caterpillar.

items.name: cta-013
items.title: Липкая полоса
items.description: Тонкий бар-анонс с одним сообщением и одной кнопкой. Позиционирование статическое: где полосе липнуть — верх, низ, над подвалом — решает страница.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-cta-013-*. Серверный компонент, размечен как <aside>: полоса — дополнение к странице, а не её раздел. Позиционирование намеренно статическое — прилипание задаётся снаружи через className (position:sticky и top, z-index по вкусу проекта). Фон бара — тёплый тинт от акцента через color-mix поверх прозрачного, поэтому полоса заметна на любом цвете страницы, не пряча его.

en.title: Sticky Bar CTA
en.description: A thin announcement bar with one message and one button. The positioning is static: where the bar sticks — top, bottom, above the footer — is the page's decision.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-013-* variables. A server component marked up as <aside>: the bar is an addition to the page, not a section of it. The positioning is deliberately static — sticking is applied from outside through className (position:sticky with top, z-index to the project's taste). The bar background is a warm accent tint through color-mix over transparency, so the bar stays visible on any page colour without hiding it.

ai.summary: A thin announcement bar: a bold message, a muted detail and a small accent button in one line. The position is static; sticking is added from outside. No client JS. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.
preserve: the local --vibeui-cta-013-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the static positioning: where the bar sticks is the page's decision — sticking is applied from outside through className, while a position:fixed baked into the block would fight any layout
the warm bar tint through color-mix from the accent over transparency — the bar stays visible on any page colour without painting over it
the thin vertical padding: a bar that sticks to the screen has no right to eat its height
the <aside> markup — the bar is an addition to the page, not a section of it
the different weight of the message and the detail: bold for what happened, muted for what to do
the button wrapping to a new line through flex-wrap in a narrow column rather than squeezing the text
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette and the layout
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: message and detail — the message and the detail
actionLabel and actionHref — the button
sticking through className: sticky top-0 plus your project's z-index
the accent through the accent prop — it colours the tint and the button
background — the layer under the tint; empty means no background, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
To make the bar stick: add position:sticky (or fixed) with top:0 through className and a z-index above the page content.
There is deliberately no close button: a "hidden" state needs JS and stored choice — add it with your own wrapper if the bar gets tiresome.
Keep the message to one thought: a bar that takes more than two seconds to read is already a section.
One bar per page; a bar on top of a bar is a sure way to get the tab closed.

en.title: App QR CTA
en.description: An app-install CTA: store plaques without brand logos and a QR placeholder drawn as a CSS pattern on a white plate.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-cta-015-* variables. A server component. The QR placeholder is a repeating-conic-gradient checker pattern with three corner finder markers made of pseudo-elements, marked aria-hidden: it is a mock of the place for a real code. The plate under the QR is always white and the pattern always dark — a scanner needs a dark drawing on a light ground, and darkening the plate with the theme is not allowed. The store plaques are drawn as text, with no brand logos. From 46rem the text and the QR stand side by side.

ai.summary: A two-column app-install CTA: on the left a heading, an explanation and store plaques; on the right a white plate with a QR placeholder and a caption. The QR and the plaques are drawn in CSS, no external files. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-cta-015-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
aria-hidden on the QR placeholder: it is a mock of the place for a real code, a screen reader has nothing to read there
the white plate and the dark QR pattern in both themes — a scanner needs a dark drawing on a light ground, and a QR darkened with the theme stops scanning
the three corner finder markers: they are what makes the pattern recognisable as a QR, without them it is just a checkerboard
the store plaques drawn as text with no brand logos — store logos are third-party trademarks with usage rules of their own
the plaques as <a> links rather than buttons: the way to a store is navigation and has to work without JS
the two-column layout driven by the block's own width: in a narrow column the QR drops under the text
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the pattern and the layout
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
the platform marks in the badges (Apple for iOS, the robot for Android) — matched by the store name, no external icon set
adapt: eyebrow, title and description — the eyebrow, the heading and the explanation
badges — the plaque captions and addresses (caption, store, href)
qrCaption — the caption under the QR
the accent through the accent prop — it colours the eyebrow and the focus rings
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour
outer spacing through className
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The placeholder does not scan: before launch replace [data-part="qr"] with a real QR — an image or your own generator.
Official store badges come from their brand guidelines, each with its own rules for sizes and margins.
Point both plaques at the apps' real store addresses, not at the site's home page.
Do not recolour the QR pattern into the accent: contrast and scannability outrank the brand.
